thread:
Maya: Quick preflight — need a final checklist for the webinar launch SEO: keywords, schema, internal linking, redirects. Keep it short. @Tom @Liam :pray:

Tom: On it. I'll assemble KW targets and the landing redirects. Which benchmark post should we surface in the launch post?

Liam: Use last week's latency/cost benchmark as the canonical reference. Also recommend routing leads to /webinars/redwood-inference-qa. We should add redirects for the old promo page.

Olivia: I'll prepare a webinarEvent JSON-LD snippet and a small FAQ schema. Want FAQ on the blog or as a separate accordion on the page?

Maya: Blog is fine but add FAQ schema on the blog page. Also double-check canonical tags and internal links from blog -> docs/pricing.

Tom: Draft KW list: "LLM inference platform", "low-latency LLM serving", "serve LLMs at scale", "inference cost optimization". Redirect rules I'll propose:
- /promo/webinar-2025 -> /webinars/redwood-inference-qa
- /benchmarks/latest -> /benchmarks/2026-latency-cost
- regex: ^/webinar.* -> /webinars/redwood-inference-qa
I'll open a PR for nginx redirects and Netlify config.

Liam: Add UTM params for email CTA and GA4 event mapping. Also create a staging fallback redirect for old URLs so tests don't 404.

seo-bot: Redirect PR created by Tom: #3421 — preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/3421 (deployed to staging)

Olivia: JSON-LD (rough, will refine):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch + Benchmarks Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-03-30T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.com/webinars/redwood-inference-qa"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```

Maya: Perfect — Tom/Liam/Olivia, please add tasks to the launch Trello and tag me. I'd like final review by EOD Wednesday. :rocket:
